paras: Take your VW Golf MK7 & MK7.5 R to the next level with the all-new XFORCE VAREX cat-back exhaust system. Crafted from high-quality 304-grade stainless steel, this precision-engineered system features a 3” free-flowing design and an new VAREX valved muffler, to enhance both performance and sound adjustability.

At the core of this system is XFORCE’s innovative VAREX technology, allowing you to seamlessly switch between an aggressive, race-inspired growl and a refined, street-friendly tone—all at the push of a button. Whether you’re tearing up the track or cruising through the city, you have full control over your exhaust note.
